messages.subject: Question: conditional sum
parts:

There is probably a simple and elegant solution to this, but I don't
seem to find it. I wonder if anybody could help me?

I have a lage ecological data set that looks like this:

> ZplDataSpecies[1:12,]

Each sample in my data is uniquely defined by the combination of index
and min. What I would need to do is to summarise the values of
"abund.ind.m3" and "wetw.mg.m3" over all equal "latin" values within
each sample. That is, the result I need would look something like
this:

index station sea.area max min
latin abund.ind.m3 wetw.mg.m3
1979010053 F64 D 25 0 Acartia longiremis 3.765 0.226
1979010053 F64 D 25 0 Acartia sp. 916.079 1.683

576.000 31.398


So, the "id" becomes redundant as I summarise over all "id"s; the rest
of the variables stay the same within each sample. However, I would
need to keep them in the data since I need to perform operations based
on them later.

I hope my explanation made sense! I'd really appreciate if anybody
could help me with this problem!

Thanks!

Laura Uusitalo, PhD (fishery science)

messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: Re: Question: conditional sum
parts:
Something like:

ddply(ZplDataSpecies, .(grouping variables here, see below example), summarise, 
put here whatever calculations you want, see below example
)

an example with the baseball data set in the plyr pacakge:
ddply(baseball[1:1000,], .(id, team), summarise, 
meanrbi = mean(rbi), 
meanh = mean(h)
)

When including a sample of your data, please use 'dput' to create it.
I had to remove embedded line feeds and put quotes around values that
included embedded spaces.

Here is a possible way using the 'data.table' package.

> x <- read.table(textConnection("index station sea.area max min latin id abund.ind.m3 wetw.mg.m3 year month day group
+ 1 1979010335 LL7 F 25 0 'Acartia longiremis' 3

+ 12 1979010335 LL7 F 25 0 'Keratella quadrata'
1 20.078 4.0156 1979 7 30 3")
+ , header = TRUE)
> closeAllConnections()
>
> require(data.table)
> x.dt <- data.table(x)
> x.dt[, list(abund.ind.m3 = mean(abund.ind.m3)
+ , wetw.mg.m3 = mean(wetw.mg.m3)
+ ), by = c('index', 'min', 'latin')]
index min latin abund.ind.m3 wetw.mg.m3
[1,] 1979010335 0 Acartia longiremis 20.078 1.606000
[2,] 1979010335 0 Acartia sp. 1676.549 106.667000
[3,] 1979010335 0 Bosmina coregoni maritima 421.647 2.951500
[4,] 1979010335 0 Eurytemora sp. 314.562 9.771667
[5,] 1979010335 0 Evadne nordmanni 401.569 4.016000
[6,] 1979010335 0 Keratella quadrata 20.078 4.015600
